'''exarthesophist Watto's Destiny''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[exarthesophist]]
* '''Published:''' 17 May 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif|label=No Money, No Parts, No Deal!}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|First Strike|SE-D-firststrike.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 NMNPND exarthesophist DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I have been working on my decks more since I got back into the game. This is one that I have just recently thrown back together. Tell me what you think.

The published list has 59 cards.

The post names no Defensive Shields ('[looking for 2 other starting effects]').

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published: the author says the list 'should/does not total up to 60 cards' and he is still looking for 2 more starting effects. The Effects/Interrupts header says 22 but the list has 21.
* The Emperor's Prize, We're The Bait and We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! are unmarked (posted with '(destiny)' notes): the printed cards. The draft had read them as (V) cards.
* Posted 'Dark Maneuvers/Talon Role' dested Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll; 'Your Powers Are Week Old man' Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man; 'Imperial-class Star Destoyer' / 'Victory-class Star Destroy' the Imperial-/Victory-Class Star Destroyer.

== Strategy ==

This isn't much of a beatdown deck, although if needed it could easily be considered as such. As you can guess there is a reason why I have so many destiny-pulling interrupts and rather bulky characters. My basic point of this deck is to take them out with drains, battles, and Watto.
